selection_protocol_justification: Subject-level stratified split (random_state=42, test_size=0.2) placed 81 subjects (262 samples) into training and 21 subjects (73 samples) into held-out test partition with zero patient leakage. The primary evaluation utilizes all 73 held-out test samples (47 Control, 26 AD) across all 21 held-out subjects. A balanced test subset of exactly 15 AD and 15 Control samples (random_state=42) across 16 subjects is retained as supplementary analysis. The remaining 43 samples (32 Control, 11 AD) from the same 21 held-out subjects are explicitly labeled as HELD_OUT_TEST_UNBALANCED_REMAINDER to disclose that they are unused samples from the same held-out subjects, not a separate independent validation cohort.
